hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgit\s+(commit|push)\b'; then hit=$( (git ls-files; git diff --cached --name-only) | grep -E '(^|/)(config\.json|\.env|[^/]*\.key|[^/]*\.pem)$' ); if [ -n "$hit" ]; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Sensitive file(s) staged/tracked, blocking commit/push:\n%s"}' "$hit"; exit 0; fi; fi; exit 0; }
